item.title: 'It's just human instinct': Man who shielded teen in West Valley auto-pedestrian accident speaks out
item.description: A week after two pedestrians were hospitalized after being hit in back-to-back accidents, one of them is speaking out about how he was hit while trying to help.

item.title: 'Very warm, sweet, kind young man': Family speaks about carbon monoxide poisoning victim after suspect appears in court
item.description: Following the initial court appearance of the man charged with triple homicide in a West Valley City carbon monoxide poisoning, the family of one of the victims spoke on their loss.

item.title: Salt Lake City unveils new concept designs for Jefferson Park, requests public input
item.description: The Salt Lake City Department of Public Lands has unveiled two proposed concept designs for the new and improved Jefferson Park, and they are asking the public to help decide which one is the best fit.

item.title: Vote to move bill banning public employee insurance from covering transgender healthcare out of committee fails
item.description: After previously passing the House, the bill that would stop public employees' insurance from covering transgender health care failed to make it out of committee on Thursday.

item.title: TRAFFIC ALERT: Vehicle crash in Murray causes road closure
item.description: A vehicle crash in Murray has led to road closures.

item.title: Department of Natural Resources provides update on Utah water conditions following storm
item.description: Following the recent snow, the Utah Department of Natural Resources (DNR) has provided an update on current water conditions.

item.title: St. George Police Detective recognized by FBI for casework
item.description: A St. George Police Detective received national recognition from the FBI for his work on a local sex abuse case.

item.title: Intermountain Children's Health launches pediatric telestroke network
item.description: On Thursday, Intermountain Children's Health launched the nation's largest pediatric telestroke network--allowing children to get lifesaving diagnoses wherever they are.

item.title: Washington County Sheriff gives update on partnership with ICE
item.description: The Washington County Sheriff spoke today about local cooperation with U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE), after entering into an agreement with the agency last year.

item.title: Snowfall spurs avalanche mitigation across Utah mountains
item.description: From southern Utah to northern Utah, ski resorts are stepping up avalanche mitigation efforts as snow continues to fall.
